ASU Gammage Parking Guide: Drop-Off, Bag Policy and the 2026–27 Broadway Season

Scottsdale Sprinters’ short answer on ASU Gammage parking: for Broadway shows it is included in the ticket, in the Gold Lot for subscribers and accessible parking and in the Maroon Garage on Apache Boulevard for everyone else. The theatre is at 1200 S. Forest Avenue on the ASU campus in Tempe, allows one carry-in item per person, and asks guests to arrive an hour early. Coming up: the Grinch musical on December 1 to 6, 2026 and Beetlejuice on January 1 to 3, 2027. For a date night, a family or a group, one chauffeured vehicle replaces the garage and the walk.

Last updated: September 26, 2026

Prices start at $125 an hour for the Luxury SUV (Suburban), which seats 6, on a 4-hour minimum, so the shortest booking is $500 before 8% tax. Every vehicle is booked by the hour at its published rate and minimum, with no per-seat pricing.

Where is ASU Gammage?

ASU Gammage is at 1200 S. Forest Avenue, Tempe, AZ 85281, on the Tempe campus of Arizona State University, where Broadway’s touring productions play the Valley. Frank Lloyd Wright designed the building, and the house has three seating levels: the orchestra, the grand tier and the balcony. The casts are the professional touring Broadway companies, not student productions, the venue says. Its box office opens two hours before events on performance days, and tickets are sold only through ASU Gammage and Ticketmaster; third-party sellers are not authorized. The theatre’s own lot, the Gold Lot, is Lot 3, entered from S. Forest Avenue at Lemon Street. The Maroon Garage, the Apache Boulevard structure, is entered from S. Normal Avenue north of Apache Boulevard.

How does parking work at ASU Gammage?

For Broadway, Beyond and School of Music performances, parking at ASU Gammage is included in the ticket price. On Broadway nights the Gold Lot is reserved for subscribers and guests who need accessible parking, and when it fills every guest is sent to the Maroon Garage, the Apache Boulevard structure. For shows outside those series the Gold Lot is open to all ticket holders, and separate parking fees may apply; ASU Gammage publishes no figure for them. The Maroon Lot is open to all ticket holders for every event. Accessible parking is available in every area, with dedicated spaces held in the Gold Lot. For the front Orchestra’s accessible seats, the venue says to use the North entrance for the elevator. ASU Gammage asks everyone to arrive at least an hour before the performance, to park, clear security and be seated; latecomers wait for a break in the show.

Where do rideshare and chauffeured groups drop off at ASU Gammage?

ASU Gammage publishes no rideshare, limo or charter zone, so a chauffeured group unloads where ASU Gammage and ASU staff direct on the night. Its parking and accessibility pages do name designated drop-off areas at both theatre entrances, in their accessible-parking notes, where a driver can let members of a party out before parking. Nothing here is a reserved lane for booked vehicles. The chauffeur drives the approach the night allows, lets the group out where staff direct, and agrees one pickup point for after the curtain call. If the venue publishes a drop-off plan for a show, that plan replaces this paragraph. A guest who needs the elevator to the front Orchestra goes to the North entrance; tell us when you book and we plan the drop-off around it.

What is the ASU Gammage bag policy?

ASU Gammage screens every guest with metal detectors and allows one carry-in item per person: a clear bag up to 12 by 6 by 12 inches, or a small purse or bag, clear or not, up to 8.5 by 5.5 inches, about a folded sheet of letter paper. Every bag is subject to search, and the strap does not count. Not allowed: weapons of any kind, pepper spray, any non-clear bag larger than the small-purse size, drinks and drink containers, full-size strollers, and wrapped presents or packages, which must be unwrapped to be inspected. A factory-sealed water, or an empty plastic or metal bottle of 32 ounces or less, is allowed. Items that fail the check go back to the owner’s car or in the bin, the venue says. A group that is dropped off has no car in the garage to walk back to, so settle bags and holiday gifts at the hotel. The detectors use no magnetic waves and are safe with a pacemaker.

How do you get to ASU Gammage?

Drivers reach ASU Gammage from Apache Boulevard: the venue’s directions leave US 60 at Mill Avenue (exit 173) or Rural Road, Loop 101 at Broadway Road or University Drive by the Price Road frontage, and Loop 202 at Scottsdale Road, then turn north on S. Forest Avenue for the Gold Lot or S. Normal Avenue for the Maroon Garage. Valley Metro lists four connections at ASU Gammage: bus Route 66 (Mill Avenue and Kyrene Road), FLASH, Orbit Jupiter and the Tempe Streetcar. It lists no light rail station as a connection there. A chauffeured ride skips the choice of lot and exit. We drive from Scottsdale, Phoenix or your Tempe hotel, and nobody in the group walks a garage after the show.

What’s playing at ASU Gammage in the 2026–27 Broadway season?

The 2026–27 Broadway season at ASU Gammage runs from Phantom of the Opera, on now to October 4, 2026, through Death Becomes Her in August 2027, with Dr. Seuss’ How the Grinch Stole Christmas! The Musical on December 1 to 6, 2026 and Beetlejuice on January 1 to 3, 2027. The venue lists the season this way, as read on September 26, 2026: Phantom of the Opera: September 16 to October 4, 2026. Water for Elephants: October 27 to November 1, 2026. Dr. Seuss’ How the Grinch Stole Christmas! The Musical: December 1 to 6, 2026, a season option outside the eight-show package. Beetlejuice: January 1 to 3, 2027, a season option outside the eight-show package. The Outsiders: January 26 to 31, 2027. Operation Mincemeat: February 23 to 28, 2027. Buena Vista Social Club: April 20 to 25, 2027. Boop! The Musical: May 18 to 23, 2027. The Sound of Music: June 22 to 27, 2027. Death Becomes Her: August 24 to 29, 2027. Most runs play evenings from Tuesday to Sunday with matinees on the weekend; the Grinch adds morning and afternoon family performances. Season tickets for 2026–27 are no longer available, and the venue keeps a waitlist for the next season. Other nights on its calendar sit outside the Broadway season; check each event’s parking on its own page.

Is the Grinch musical at ASU Gammage good for kids?

Dr. Seuss’ How the Grinch Stole Christmas! The Musical plays ASU Gammage from December 1 to 6, 2026, runs 85 minutes with no intermission, and the show’s content guide on the venue’s page calls it the perfect show for audiences of all ages. It allows no babes in arms, and recommend children who can sit and concentrate for 85 minutes. ASU Gammage sets no age limit of its own and leaves the choice to parents, but everyone who attends needs a ticket, infants included. The Saturday and Sunday performances include morning and afternoon curtains, the easiest for young children. Two rules matter in December: wrapped presents are not allowed through security, and full-size strollers are not either. A family that rides together leaves gifts and the big stroller at the hotel, and has one pickup point after the show instead of a garage line with tired children.

Where can you eat before a show at ASU Gammage?

ASU Gammage’s Dinner and a Show program lists restaurants that offer deals on the day of a performance when you show your ticket, among them rooftop dining at the Canopy Hotel and the Omni Tempe Hotel at ASU, a short walk from the theatre, and restaurants at Novus Place. Each restaurant sets its own offer. The theatre’s own Portico Patio opens 90 minutes before Broadway shows with sandwiches, desserts, light refreshments, beer and wine. Only drinks bought at ASU Gammage concessions, in resealable bottles, go from the lobby into the theatre. Book the vehicle by the hour and dinner is part of the night: we drop you at the restaurant, move the group to the theatre, and wait through the show.

Which vehicle fits an ASU Gammage night?

A date night or a VIP evening takes the Maybach Jet Sprinter, the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter, the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter or the Luxury SUV (Suburban). Families at the Grinch ride the Executive Black Sprinter or the Executive White Sprinter; a girls’ night takes a Limo Sprinter; corporate and big groups take the Mini Bus (24 Pax) or the Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax). Seat counts are seated capacities from the fleet: the Maybach Jet Sprinter seats 9, the Luxury SUV (Suburban) 6, the Executive Black Sprinter 14, the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) 13 and the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) 16. The Mini Bus (24 Pax) seats 24 and the Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax) 29. Our pick for a theatre night is the Maybach Jet Sprinter, $295 an hour with a 4-hour minimum: Maybach massage recliners, an executive table and a wet bar in a private-jet cabin. The Luxury SUV (Suburban) is $125 an hour with a 4-hour minimum, and the Executive Black Sprinter is $145 an hour with a 4-hour minimum. Every rate prices the whole vehicle, before tax. A family trip with anyone under 21 is alcohol-free for the whole group, and we sell no alcohol on any trip. For a group bigger than one coach, we plan two vehicles and quote them together.

How should a group plan an ASU Gammage night?

Plan backwards from the curtain. ASU Gammage asks guests to be there at least 60 minutes before the performance, its box office opens two hours before, and the Portico Patio 90 minutes before a Broadway show, so a pickup that lands the group an hour early leaves time for security and a drink. Most shows have a 15-minute intermission; some have none, the Grinch among them. Dress is business casual for most patrons, the venue says, anything from jeans to gowns. A group of 15 or more buying together through ASU Gammage Group Services gets one ticket free for a Broadway show (some exclusions apply), and pre-show reception space for 15 to 300 guests, from the Scoular Gallery to the open-air Promenade over the campus. Book by the hour and the vehicle is yours for dinner, the show and the ride home, or book a ride there and a ride back. Reach the reservations team at (623) 986-6339 or reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com with the show, the performance, the pickup area and the rider count.

Frequently asked questions

Is parking free at ASU Gammage?

For Broadway, Beyond and School of Music performances, parking is included in the ticket price. For other events separate parking fees may apply, and ASU Gammage publishes no figure for them.

Where do you park for ASU Gammage?

On Broadway nights the Gold Lot, Lot 3 off S. Forest Avenue at Lemon Street, holds subscribers and accessible parking, and everyone else is sent to the Maroon Garage, the Apache Boulevard structure off S. Normal Avenue.

What size bag can you bring to ASU Gammage?

One item per person: a clear bag up to 12 by 6 by 12 inches, or a small purse up to 8.5 by 5.5 inches. Everyone passes metal detectors, and wrapped presents are not allowed.

What is the address of ASU Gammage?

1200 S. Forest Avenue, Tempe, AZ 85281, on the Arizona State University campus.

When is the Grinch musical at ASU Gammage?

Dr. Seuss’ How the Grinch Stole Christmas! The Musical plays December 1 to 6, 2026, with morning and afternoon performances on the weekend. It runs 85 minutes with no intermission.

When is Beetlejuice at ASU Gammage?

Beetlejuice returns to ASU Gammage January 1 to 3, 2027, opening on New Year’s Day.

How early should you arrive at ASU Gammage?

At least an hour before the performance, the venue says, to park, clear security and be seated. Latecomers wait for a break in the show.

Can a limo or Sprinter drop off at ASU Gammage?

Yes, where ASU Gammage and ASU staff direct on the night. The venue publishes no limo or rideshare zone, so the chauffeur confirms the drop-off for your show and agrees one pickup point for the ride home.

Is there light rail to ASU Gammage?

Valley Metro lists no light rail station as a connection at ASU Gammage. It lists bus Route 66, FLASH, Orbit Jupiter and the Tempe Streetcar.

What should you wear to ASU Gammage?

There is no formal dress code. Most patrons wear business casual, and the venue says anything from jeans to gowns is fine.
